1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.

<script>
(()=>{
const canvas=document.querySelector('#game'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const ui={overlay:document.querySelector('#overlay'),title:document.querySelector('#modalTitle'),kicker:document.querySelector('#modalKicker'),text:document.querySelector('#modalText'),main:document.querySelector('#mainBtn'),note:document.querySelector('#modalNote'),result:document.querySelector('#result'),final:document.querySelector('#finalScore'),best:document.querySelector('#bestScore'),score:document.querySelector('#score'),timer:document.querySelector('#timer'),sector:document.querySelector('#sector'),hearts:[...document.querySelectorAll('.heart')],pause:document.querySelector('#pauseBtn'),stick:document.querySelector('#stick'),knob:document.querySelector('#stickKnob'),dash:document.querySelector('#dashBtn')};
let W=1000,H=562,dpr=1,state='menu',last=0,elapsed=0,score=0,spawnTimer=0,shotTimer=0,shake=0,flash=0,entities=[],bullets=[],foes=[],bits=[],stars=[],keys={},pointer={x:0,y:0,active:false},joy={x:0,y:0},dashCooldown=0,player, best=Number(localStorage.getItem('starline-best')||0), mobile=matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches;
const rand=(a,b)=>a+Math.random()*(b-a),clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
function resize(){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();if(!r.width)return;dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);canvas.width=Math.round(r.width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(r.height*dpr);W=1000;H=1000*r.height/r.width;ctx.setTransform(canvas.width/W,0,0,canvas.height/H,0,0);stars=Array.from({length:Math.round(W*H/8500)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,z:rand(.35,1),p:rand(0,6.3)}));if(player){player.x=clamp(player.x,25,W-25);player.y=clamp(player.y,25,H-25)}}
new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);resize();
function reset(){elapsed=0;score=0;spawnTimer=.45;shotTimer=0;shake=0;flash=0;dashCooldown=0;entities=[];bullets=[];foes=[];bits=[];player={x:W/2,y:H/2,r:12,hp:3,invuln:0,dash:0,angle:-Math.PI/2};for(let i=0;i<5;i++)spawnFoe(true);updateHud()}
function start(){reset();state='playing';ui.overlay.classList.add('hidden');ui.pause.disabled=false;last=performance.now()}
function showOverlay(kind){ui.overlay.classList.remove('hidden');ui.result.classList.remove('show');if(kind==='pause'){ui.kicker.textContent='Flight systems on standby';ui.title.textContent='Catch your breath.';ui.text.textContent='The swarm is waiting out there. Resume when you’re ready.';ui.main.textContent='Resume mission';ui.note.textContent='Press P or ESC to return to the fight';ui.main.onclick=resume}
else if(kind==='over'){ui.kicker.textContent='Signal lost / mission complete';ui.title.textContent='You held the line.';ui.text.textContent='The stars will remember your run, pilot. Ready to take another shot at the swarm?';ui.result.classList.add('show');ui.final.textContent=score.toLocaleString();ui.best.textContent=best.toLocaleString();ui.main.textContent='Fly again';ui.note.textContent='Press ENTER to launch another mission';ui.main.onclick=start}
else{ui.kicker.textContent='Transmission incoming';ui.title.textContent='The dark is moving.';ui.text.textContent='Drift through the ruins, collect fallen star shards, and keep the swarm off your tail. Your weapons target threats automatically.';ui.main.textContent='Launch mission';ui.note.textContent=mobile?'Drag the stick to move · tap DASH to burst':'WASD / ARROWS to move  ·  SPACE to dash';ui.main.onclick=start}}
function resume(){state='playing';ui.overlay.classList.add('hidden');last=performance.now()}
ui.main.onclick=start;ui.pause.onclick=()=>state==='playing'?pause():state==='paused'?resume():null;
function pause(){if(state!=='playing')return;state='paused';showOverlay('pause')}
function end(){state='over';best=Math.max(best,score);localStorage.setItem('starline-best',best);showOverlay('over')}
function updateHud(){ui.score.textContent=String(score).padStart(5,'0');ui.timer.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(elapsed/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.floor(elapsed%60)).padStart(2,'0')}`;ui.sector.textContent=String(1+Math.floor(elapsed/25)).padStart(2,'0');ui.hearts.forEach((h,i)=>h.classList.toggle('off',!player||i>=player.hp))}
function edgePoint(){const side=Math.floor(Math.random()*4);return side===0?{x:rand(10,W-10),y:-15}:side===1?{x:W+15,y:rand(10,H-10)}:side===2?{x:rand(10,W-10),y:H+15}:{x:-15,y:rand(10,H-10)}}
function spawnFoe(safe=false){const p=edgePoint(),level=1+Math.floor(elapsed/25),fast=Math.random()<Math.min(.4,.13+level*.045);foes.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,r:fast?8:12,hp:fast?1:2,speed:(fast?rand(68,88):rand(34,52))+level*3,fast,phase:rand(0,6),hit:0})}
function shard(x,y,n=1){entities.push({type:'shard',x,y,r:6,vx:rand(-45,45),vy:rand(-45,45),life:13,spin:rand(0,7),n})}
function burst(x,y,color,count=9){for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2),v=rand(30,150);bits.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*v,vy:Math.sin(a)*v,life:rand(.25,.65),max:.65,color,r:rand(1,3)})}}
function dash(){if(state!=='playing'||dashCooldown>0)return;let dx=(keys.d||keys.arrowright?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.arrowleft?1:0)+joy.x,dy=(keys.s||keys.arrowdown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.arrowup?1:0)+joy.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy);if(l<.1){dx=Math.cos(player.angle);dy=Math.sin(player.angle);l=1}player.x=clamp(player.x+dx/l*112,16,W-16);player.y=clamp(player.y+dy/l*112,16,H-16);player.dash=.23;player.invuln=.48;dashCooldown=1.35;shake=7;burst(player.x,player.y,'#62f5e6',15)}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{const k=e.key.toLowerCase();if([' ','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k))e.preventDefault();keys[k]=true;if(k===' '&&!e.repeat)dash();if((k==='p'||k==='escape')&&!e.repeat){if(state==='playing')pause();else if(state==='paused')resume()}if(k==='enter'&&state==='over')start()});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=false});window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{keys={};if(state==='playing')pause()});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();pointer.x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*W;pointer.y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H;pointer.active=true});canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='touch'){const r=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();pointer.x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*W;pointer.y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H;pointer.active=true}});
let stickId=null;ui.stick.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{stickId=e.pointerId;ui.stick.setPointerCapture(stickId);moveStick(e)});ui.stick.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId===stickId)moveStick(e)});function moveStick(e){const r=ui.stick.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=e.clientX-(r.left+r.width/2),dy=e.clientY-(r.top+r.height/2),m=Math.min(30,Math.hypot(dx,dy)),a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);joy.x=Math.cos(a)*m/30;joy.y=Math.sin(a)*m/30;ui.knob.style.transform=`translate(${joy.x*m}px,${joy.y*m}px)`}function endStick(e){if(e.pointerId!==stickId)return;stickId=null;joy={x:0,y:0};ui.knob.style.transform=''}ui.stick.addEventListener('pointerup',endStick);ui.stick.addEventListener('pointercancel',endStick);ui.dash.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();dash()});

<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Last Light

A self-contained arcade survival game. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with any static web server) to play.

- **Move:** WASD or arrow keys
- **Dash:** Space (short cooldown)
- **Pause / resume:** P or Escape
- **Mobile:** drag the on-screen joystick and tap **Dash**

Survive the swarm, let your auto-targeting ship handle the shooting, and collect the star shards for points. Your best score is saved in the browser.

Built **Last Light**, a complete, playable space-survival arcade game in `index.html`. It includes automatic targeting, enemy waves that grow over time, collectible shards, dash, hull health, pause/resume, game-over and replay, and a saved best score. Keyboard and mobile touch controls are supported.

Updated `README.md` with controls and run instructions. Verified JavaScript syntax and checked gameplay and the mobile layout in Chromium. I assumed a self-contained browser game was the right fit for this otherwise empty project.
